DIAGNOSIS: Anorexia nervosa (restricting type) with significantly low body weight

Alternatives to consider:
1. Hyperthyroidism (euthyroid sick syndrome or masked presentation)
2. Malabsorption syndrome (e.g., atypical inflammatory bowel disease or pancreatic insufficiency)
3. Addison's disease
